title: feat(console): the Audit Log drawer opens the selected row's record page, which lists the other changes to the same record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoVs9GksKU3yRatBp1PXVJMd)_

Fixes #30748

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two new console keys (`console.system.auditLog.openEntryPage`, `console.system.auditLog.openEntryPageHint`) ship in every published `@object-ui/i18n` pack; nothing is narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → 审计日志的详情抽屉里加了一个「打开条目页」按钮，点开就是这条审计行自己的记录页；行上带 `record_id` 时，按钮下方一句话说明那一页会列出同一记录的全部变更。十种内置语言都有这两句文案。
- 为什么改：设置写入记下的 `config_change` 行只有摘要，看不到改成了什么值；值在 CRUD 镜像写的同一设置行的 update 行里。服务端一半（#30728）已经让审计记录页按 `record_id` 列出同记录的所有行，但管理员实际看审计的这个页面没有入口通向那一页。
- 风险与回滚：只加一个链接和两条文案，不改任何读取；记录页本身和它的读权限、脱敏都是服务端既有的。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`（抽屉头部新增的链接块与 `entryPageHref`）；`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.entryPage-30748.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.entryPage-30748.test.tsx`，预期 5 条全绿；或在 Setup → 审计日志点开一条设置变更行，点「打开条目页」，记录页下方「同一记录的变更」里能看到镜像的 update 行和新旧值。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Setup → Audit Log (`AuditLogPage.tsx`) is a custom page: a row click opens its own drawer, and nothing there reached the row's record page. Since #30728 the platform serves a default record page for `sys_audit_log` (`sys_audit_log_detail`, `plugin-audit`) whose related list holds every ledger row with the same `record_id`. A settings write's `config_change` row carries only a digest; the CRUD mirror's rows about the same settings row hold the value, one row down on that page.

- The drawer header gains an **Open entry page** link (`entryPageHref`): the console's record route for `sys_audit_log` and the selected row's id, under the app segment the page is mounted in (the same `listBase` "Open as list" uses, `setup` when none). It is offered on every row with an id: a row about no record still has its own page.
- The link carries `state.from` back to this page, labelled by the page title, the shape the Approvals Inbox hands its record links, so the record page's crumb row leads back here in an app whose navigation does not list `sys_audit_log`.
- On a row that carries a `record_id`, one muted line under the link says the entry page lists every change to the same record, newest first.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `console.system.auditLog.openEntryPage` and `console.system.auditLog.openEntryPageHint` in all ten built-in packs. The page header's title now reads from one `pageTitle` constant shared with the link state.

The card's second option (listing the same-`record_id` rows inside the drawer) was not taken: the record page already makes that read through the data API under the ledger's read gate and redaction, and a second list in the drawer would be a copy of it.

## Tests

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.entryPage-30748.test.tsx` (new, 5 tests), through a real router: the page at `/apps/:appName/system/audit-log` as `systemRoutes` mounts it, and a probe on `/apps/:appName/:objectName/record/:recordId`.

- on a `config_change` row the drawer links to `/apps/setup/sys_audit_log/record/ROW_ID` (that row's id) and shows the hint;
- clicking it lands on the record route with that id, `state.from` = this page and its title, and the landed row's `record_id` is the one the mirror's update row names;
- the app segment follows the mount (`/apps/crm/...`);
- a row with no `record_id` still links to its own page, without the hint;
- under zh the link and the hint read the zh pack (guarded as real zh rows).

What this file does not pin, because it lives elsewhere: the page's same-record list (`plugin-audit` `sys-audit-log-page.test.ts`, "the same-record list is the ledger, keyed on `record_id` on both sides, newest first, with no New") and the related list's `relationshipValueField` read (`plugin-detail`, `record-related-list.relationshipValueFieldUncast-9475.test.tsx`).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's pin ("on a `config_change` row the drawer reaches the mirror's update row") is held as a chain: this PR pins drawer → the row's record route; the two named tests above pin route page → same-`record_id` list. No test here mounts the full record page.
- The language-pack addition costs the eager `i18n-locale-en` chunk a few dozen bytes; measured below, headroom stays about 2.9 KB of the 60,000-byte ceiling, ceiling untouched.
- The first commit on the branch (`b85081cd`, a WIP commit) carries no `Claude-Session` / `Co-authored-by` trailer pair; the branch is not force-pushable under AGENTS §3, so it stays. Later commits carry the pair.
